Name: Rehoboth by the River
ModernLocation: Unknown; proposed sites include Ras Rihab near Wadi Ghuwayr
Description: A city named as the home of Saul, a king of Edom, described as Rehoboth by the river; distinct from the Assyrian Rehoboth and from Isaac's well.
BiblicalSignificance: Rehoboth by the River belongs to the early king list of Edom before Israel had a king.
